zh.title: 捷藍航空將於12月在3條航線推出BlueFirst
zh.summary: 捷藍航空將於12月推出BlueFirst，3條航線機票已開賣
body: Simple Flying報導，捷藍航空（JetBlue）計畫於12月在3條航線推出BlueFirst。相關航班已開放購票，並提供導入優惠票價。
報導摘要指出，BlueFirst的彈性套裝結合優先行李與優先登機，並搭配升級的機艙體驗。這些是摘要所列的套裝內容；報導提及的推出安排、航線數量與售票資訊，均與BlueFirst的12月推出計畫一同發布。

en.title: JetBlue plans December BlueFirst debut on three routes with introductory fares
en.summary: JetBlue plans a December BlueFirst debut on three routes, with flights on sale at introductory fares.
body: Simple Flying reports that JetBlue plans to debut BlueFirst in December on three routes. Flights are on sale with introductory fares. The report's summary describes flexible BlueFirst bundles that pair priority bags and boarding with an elevated in-cabin experience on the launch routes.

The reported plan therefore includes a December launch, three routes and flights already available for purchase at introductory fares. The summary also identifies the bundle features: priority bags, priority boarding and an elevated in-cabin experience. It presents these as elements of the flexible BlueFirst bundles associated with the launch routes.

zh.title: 達美航空宣佈波士頓與雷克雅維克新增波音757-200航班
zh.summary: 達美航空宣佈波士頓與雷克雅維克新增2027年跨大西洋航班
body: 達美航空宣佈新增波士頓與雷克雅維克之間的波音757-200航班。Simple Flying的報導摘要將這項安排列入2027年新的跨大西洋航班時刻表，並稱其可延伸波士頓的歐洲航網。
摘要也將這些航班描述為達美航空往返雷克雅維克直飛服務的新增部分。公告列出波士頓與雷克雅維克這組航點、波音757-200機型，以及2027年跨大西洋航班安排。

en.title: Delta Announces New Boeing 757-200 Flights Between Boston and Reykjavík
en.summary: Delta announces new Boston–Reykjavík Boeing 757-200 flights in its 2027 transatlantic schedule.
body: Delta Air Lines has announced new Boeing 757-200 flights between Boston and Reykjavík. Simple Flying’s summary places the flights in a new 2027 transatlantic schedule and says the schedule extends Boston’s European reach.

The summary also describes the flights as joining Delta’s growing nonstop services to Reykjavík. The announcement names Boston and Reykjavík as the city pair, specifies the Boeing 757-200, and places the schedule in 2027.

zh.title: 美國南部邊境無人機限制生效 禁止未授權活動
zh.summary: 美國南部邊境無人機臨時限制生效，禁止未授權活動並延伸一海里。
body: 美國運輸部（DOT）、Department of War（DoW）與國土安全部（DHS）宣佈，已在美國南部邊境實施無人機臨時飛航限制。限制自今日生效，禁止未經授權的無人機活動；適用範圍自地面至離地400英尺，並沿美國與墨西哥邊界向北延伸一海里。
FAA表示，將發布NOTAM，並在其中提供Domestic Notice與FAA UAS Data Delivery System的連結。無人機操作人員須在作業前檢視所有適用的NOTAM與限制，並遵守預定作業適用的規定。

en.title: U.S. Activates Restrictions on Unauthorized Drones Along Southern Border
en.summary: The U.S. activates a temporary drone restriction extending one nautical mile north of the southern border.
body: The U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), Department of War (DoW) and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) announced a coordinated temporary flight restriction for drones along the southern U.S. border. The restriction is effective today. It prohibits unauthorized drone activity from the surface to 400 feet above ground level and extends one nautical mile north of the U.S.-Mexico border.

The FAA said it will publish a NOTAM with links to the Domestic Notice and the FAA's UAS Data Delivery System. Drone operators are responsible for reviewing all applicable NOTAMs and restrictions before operating, and must comply with the requirements in effect for their planned operations.

zh.title: 臺銀無人機共同供應契約簽約 詠昇取得訓練機組品項
zh.summary: 詠昇電子簽約供應訓練無人機組；預估需求3,894臺、金額約1.32億元
body: 世紀民生旗下詠昇電子取得臺灣銀行採購部無人機組共同供應契約中的「訓練用無人機組」品項，並於今天完成簽約。各機關預估採購需求為3,894臺，預估契約金額約新臺幣1.32億元。
中央社報導，臺灣銀行採購部代理內政部等9個部會辦理此案。適用契約的政府機關、學校及公營事業，可依契約規定與實際需求辦理訂購。報導所列數量及金額均為預估。

en.title: 詠昇電子 Signs 台灣銀行 Drone Supply Contract for Training Sets
en.summary: 詠昇電子 signs a training-drone contract; estimated demand is 3,894 units.
body: 詠昇電子, a subsidiary of 世紀民生, secured the “training drone set” item under 台灣銀行採購部’s joint supply contract for drone sets and completed signing today. Estimated procurement demand from agencies is 3,894 units, and the estimated contract value is about NT$132 million.

The report says 台灣銀行採購部 handled the case on behalf of the Ministry of the Interior and other government departments. Government agencies, schools and state-owned enterprises covered by the contract may place orders according to its terms and their actual needs. The reported quantity and value are estimates.
